text:
Elaine (infra-ops): FYI GCP sent a notice: effective in ~30 days H100 spot & on-demand in eu-west1 + neighbouring zones will increase ~18-22% for certain SKUs. Need a quick pass on how this shifts our unit economics for Dedicated/reserved capacity and hosted pricing. 
Samir (finance): Ouch. Can you paste the specific SKUs/percentages? We need committed vs on-demand delta to rerun margin checks. Also any affected reserved contract renewals?
Elaine (infra-ops): Pasted from their mail: 
- nvidia-h100-80gb: +20% on-demand, reserved term unchanged for 1/3/5yr standard RIs but new purchases priced 12% higher vs last quarter.
- a100-40gb: +18% on-demand, reserved up 8% for new SKUs.
Jordan (serving): Important: our Dedicated pools in eu-west1 are ~40% H100, 50% A100, rest misc. If on-demand jumps 20% SLO-backed fallback costs spike. Need per-token cost update.
Amy (product): Also callout packaging: if we reprice hosted API, we risk churn. Can we absorb some via more aggressive batching / cache settings first? 
Lucas (sre): Health note — same notice hinted at regional capacity constraints; might be preemptive price signal. If capacity tightens, our routing fallback to other regions will increase egress and latency. Include egress delta in econ model.
cost-bot: Automated cost-alert: region=eu-west1 sku_group=h100,a100 on-demand_change=+20% notified_at=1829954000
Samir (finance): Quick back-of-envelope: current blended infra cost per 1M tokens in eu-west1 w/ reserved mix = $120. If on-demand portion increases 20% and we continue same routing, blended cost -> ~$132 (10% overall). We should run three scenarios: conservative (12% reserved step-up), realistic (20% on-demand shock), worst (20% + egress/regional premium).
Jordan (serving): I'll throw a quick script to recompute per-route unit cost. Will include: reserved amortization, preemptible/spot mix, egress penalty when cross-region routing. Sample calc I used earlier: 
```
# pseudocalc per million tokens
reserved_monthly = 50000  # $
on_demand_monthly = 20000 # $ before shock
on_demand_shocked = on_demand_monthly * 1.2
blended = (reserved_monthly + on_demand_shocked) / 1_000_000
print(blended)
```
I’ll attach numbers in 15m.
Samir (finance): Also remember we have committed contracts rolling in next quarter for a subset of customers. If unit cost rises 10% we may need a price delta or margin compression for Q+. Put estimates for: hosted margin impact, Dedicated margin impact, and reserve reprice effect on sales comps.
Elaine (infra-ops): Action item: Jordan to run per-pool calc, Lucas to surface any capacity forecasts from cloud account team (are limits likely?), Samir to run margin scenarios, Amy to draft comms/pricing guardrails if we need to shift.
Amy (product): If margin hit >8% for hosted, recommend a staged approach: 1) tech levers (batching/cache/quantize recommendations from Optimize), 2) temporary surcharge for large committed customers, 3) communicate at renewal. I can draft language.
Lucas (sre): I've pinged GCP TAM for capacity outlook and possible committed pricing options (private pricing). If they offer region-level committed discounts, that could offset changes — will update.
Jordan (serving): Done a quick run — preliminary numbers: blended per-1M-token cost: baseline $120 -> shocked $131.7 -> worst-case with 3% egress premium = $135.6. Adding a conservative 10% ops buffer -> $149. If we keep public hosted price unchanged, hosted margin takes ~7-10ppt hit.
Samir (finance): Good. Put those into a tiny table and I'll convert to delta vs current list prices. If margins < target for Dedicated customers we may need to reprice new offers only.
Elaine (infra-ops): Note: rebalancing some Dedicated capacity to other regions (e.g., eu-central) is possible but will add latency for EU customers; need product sign-off.
Amy (product): I'll convene a 30m sync after Jordan/Samir post numbers. Prefer to avoid broad customer-facing price change unless unavoidable. 
Samir (finance): If we decide to reprice, prefer option: grandfather existing contracts and only apply to renewals/new signups. Lower churn risk.
Jordan (serving): Uploading detailed calc in drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/costs/eu-reprice-1829954321 (WIP).
Elaine (infra-ops): Thanks — please add comments in the sheet. We'll reconvene 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
